legs.game: New England Patriots at Chicago Bears
legs.why: Rule B. Pin fair on Bears -3 is 49.3%, DK implied 50.5%, my 51.5%, within 6 points of Pin. Patriots ruled out both starting guards (Vera-Tucker, Brown) and CB Davis, Canada, Prunty; Bears pass rush faces a patched line and Bears secondary is mostly intact. Pin has seen the same report, so the edge is thin and the price is only -102.
